outcome: Placental histopathology features (anatomic, inflammation, villous maturation, and vascular mal-perfusion)
cohort: 1168 women who underwent IVF treatment and delivered at the Royal Victoria Hospital from 2009 to 2017, including 47 with PCOS and 1121 ovulatory controls
finding: IVF pregnancies in women with PCOS are associated with significant differences in placental histopathological characteristics, including important anatomic changes and vascular placental abnormalities, compared to ovulatory controls.
